_about: Public-domain John Brown of Haddington (1722-1787, Secession minister and professor of divinity) for the Word Hoard: A Compendious View of Natural and Revealed Religion (1819), A Dictionary of the Holy Bible (New York: Harper, 1839), the Essay towards an Explication of the Assembly's Shorter Catechism (New York: Carter, 1845), A Compendious History of the British Churches (Edinburgh, 1820, 2 vols) and A Brief View of the Figures of Scripture (Middlebury, 1812), raw Internet Archive OCR. CCEL and Gutenberg hold none of it. Added 2026-10-02 by lane A, round 7 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted. IA mixes him up with other John Browns; each item's title page was read.

jbrown-compendious-view-1819: A Compendious View of Natural and Revealed Religion (1819)
jbrown-dictionary-1839: A Dictionary of the Holy Bible (New York: Harper, 1839)
jbrown-catechism-1845: An Essay towards an Easy, Plain, Practical and Extensive Explication of the Assembly's Shorter Catechism (New York: Carter, 1845)
jbrown-british-churches-1: A Compendious History of the British Churches in England, Scotland, Ireland and America, vol. 1 (Edinburgh: Monteith, 1820)
jbrown-british-churches-2: A Compendious History of the British Churches in England, Scotland, Ireland and America, vol. 2 (Edinburgh: Monteith, 1820)
jbrown-figures-1812: A Brief View of the Figures, and Explication of the Metaphors, Contained in Scripture (Middlebury, Vt.: Swift, 1812)
